brief: REST vs RPC vs GraphQL — 6 calls real backend engineers make on real APIs.

slots.subText: Real backend engineers pick protocols based on team velocity, not hype. Here are the six calls that actually matter.

slots.title: Health checks and
slots.subtitle: Microservices need fast, binary chatter behind the firewall.
slots.b1Body: Protobuf shrinks payloads and skips HTTP verb debates entirely.
slots.b2Body: Generated stubs keep server and client in lockstep on every deploy.

slots.title: Fetch a single
slots.subtitle: When caching and predictability matter more than payload size.
slots.b1Body: ETags and Cache-Control headers make repeated lookups essentially free.
slots.b2Body: HTTP verbs map cleanly to CRUD, onboarding juniors in minutes.

slots.title: Query nested relational
slots.subtitle: One round-trip for a user, their posts, and comment authors.
slots.b1Body: Clients request exactly what they need, reducing over-fetching waste.
slots.b2Body: No more orchestrating five REST calls just to paint a dashboard.

slots.title: Execute a remote
slots.subtitle: Some operations are verbs, not nouns, and that is perfectly fine.
slots.b1Body: Charge, capture, and refund map to business events without URL yoga.
slots.b2Body: Bidirectional flows handle real-time logs and push notifications easily.

slots.title: Paginate and filter
slots.subtitle: Standard query parameters keep list endpoints simple and cacheable.
slots.b1Body: Every filtered view is a shareable link that hits the same cache key.
slots.b2Body: OAuth, rate limiting, and middleware are battle-tested over decades.

slots.title: Aggregate from many
slots.subtitle: A unified gateway stitches microservices into one typed schema.
slots.b1Body: Mobile and web teams each consume tailored views of the same graph.
slots.b2Body: Strong typing catches breaking changes before they reach production.

slots.ctaBody: Great engineers match the tool to the constraint. Subscribe for weekly API deep dives and real-world patterns.
